title: FairLaunch
tagline: Token launchpad with sniper prevention, sybil attack resistance, and fair algorithm distribution
description: FairLaunch.io is a sophisticated blockchain-based token launch platform designed to provide fair and transparent token distribution with built-in Sybil resistance using Self.xyz passport verification. It's built on the Celo blockchain and combines smart contract infrastructure with a modern web application.
how_its_made:
How it works:
QR Code Generation: Creates unique verification requests
Mobile App Scanning: React Native app reads NFC from passports
zk-SNARK Proofs: Generates privacy-preserving proofs
Nullifier Extraction: Prevents same passport from participating twice
On-Chain Verification: Smart contract validates proofs
